project.title: Synthetic pencil trial
project.idea: A mother and her adult daughter share a quiet moment in a modest Vietnamese kitchen.
constraints: Exactly two people: mother aged about 55, adult daughter aged about 25.
The envelope remains sealed and unopened. No dialogue or resolved ending.

draft.title: The unopened letter
draft.logline: A mother waits while her daughter decides whether to open a letter.

sections.title: A quiet pause
sections.content: In a modest Vietnamese kitchen, the mother waits beside the doorway. Her adult daughter holds an unopened envelope at the table. Cut before she opens it or answers.

scenes.title: The unopened letter
scenes.action: A middle-aged mother stands beside the doorway on the left. Her adult daughter sits at a small table on the right, holding one sealed unopened envelope in both hands. They look toward each other and wait. No one opens the envelope.
scenes.viewer_intent: Quiet hesitation; each person has space to choose.
scenes.keep_or_avoid: Two people only. Do not open the envelope or add dialogue.

staging_choices.blocking: Mother stands on the left by the doorway; daughter sits on the right at the table.
staging_choices.shot: Eye-level medium wide shot; both people and the unopened envelope visible.
